children: China insurance and healthcare platform's Q2 net operating revenue rose 72.8% yr/yr
Adjusted net profit for Q2 declined yr/yr as operating costs and expenses rose
Company approved new US$50 mln share repurchase program and US$10.8 mln cash dividend
Waterdrop says it will continue to invest in AI-driven business initiatives targeting global markets
Company expects AI deployment to enhance service efficiency and operational quality
INSURANCE INCOME GROWTH - Co said insurance-related income rose 80.5% yr/yr, driven by enhanced risk assessment services and higher first-year premiums
AI INITIATIVES - Co said AI deployment improved conversion efficiency and service quality, supporting premium growth and operational leverage
HIGHER SALES AND MARKETING COSTS - Co said sales and marketing expenses rose 220.7% yr/yr, mainly due to increased spending on third-party traffic channels and technical service fees
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the multiline insurance & brokers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Waterdrop Inc. is $2.16, about 111.8% above its September 4 closing price of $1.02
The stock recently traded at 26 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 57 three months ago
